text:
Ruchi: Auditor asked for a packet showing the RBAC emergency grant and the corresponding KMS decrypts from the 2026-03-15 incident. They want 3 sample principals, the PR/approval trail, and CloudTrail/KMS evidence. @Jordan can you scope what we can safely provide? :eyes:

Jordan: We can do that. Which key namespace — `prod-artifact-key` or `infra-deploy-key`? Also want to make sure we redact IPs/session tokens. We should attach a mapping to SOC2 control IDs.

Carlos: PR link for the change is https://git.redwood.com/r/redwood/ops/+/repos/infra/changes/1972 — note there are screenshots and a one-line emergency justification. For KMS, the key ARN is `arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/prod-artifact-key`. CloudTrail filter: `eventName=Decrypt && requestParameters.keyId = "key/prod-artifact-key"`.

Field Auditor: That's fine. We need samples across roles: a regular engineer, a service account, and an infra admin. Also want exact deltas: time of RBAC grant vs first decrypt event.

Jordan: Plan to run two pulls: (1) CloudTrail/KMS decrypts; (2) internal RBAC audit table (`rbac_events`) cross-ref. Proposed CloudTrail command (example):
```
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /cloudtrail --filter-pattern '{ ($.eventName = "Decrypt") && ($.requestParameters.keyId = "key/prod-artifact-key") }' --start-time 1678838400000 --end-time 1678842000000
```
And internal SQL: `SELECT * FROM rbac_events WHERE principal IN ('jordan','svc-deployer','k8s-admin') AND action='grant' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-15T22:50:00Z' AND '2026-03-15T23:20:00Z'`

Mina: Capture PR approval metadata too: `git log --pretty=format:"%h %an %s" -n 50 infra/changes/1972` and screenshots of the Codeowners approval. Also include the deploy metadata (deploy-bot) so auditor sees `emergency=true`.

Sam: PII/credential redaction checklist: remove IPs, session tokens, full ARNs except the KMS key id, and replace user emails with aliases. We'll need a short statement describing redaction steps in the bundle.

Ruchi: @deploy-bot why does the deploy bot show `emergency=true` in metadata? I want that captured as part of the evidence so chain-of-custody is clear.

deploy-bot: deploy: release 2026-03-15T23:05Z - metadata: `{"initiator":"jordan","emergency":true,"ticket":"INC-4321"}`

Jordan: I'll prepare a timeline: RBAC grant timestamp, PR merge timestamp, deploy with emergency tag, first KMS decrypts for each principal, and revocation timestamp. I'll redact IPs and session_tokens before exporting.

Field Auditor: Include CloudTrail eventIDs and KMS requestIDs for each decrypt so we can match artifacts. Also a short narrative describing why emergency access was required and who approved it (names + links to PR/ticket).

Ruchi: We'll provide 3 principals: `jordan` (engineer), `svc-deployer` (service account), and `k8s-admin` (infra admin). Deliverable: sanitized tarball containing (1) timeline.txt, (2) cloudtrail_decrypts.csv (redacted), (3) rbac_grants.csv, (4) PR_metadata.txt, (5) control_mapping.md linking items to SOC2 CC6.1/CC7.1 and ISO 27001 A.9.2.

Mina: Reminder — when you export CloudTrail rows, include `eventID`, `eventTime`, `userIdentity.principalId`, and `requestParameters` so the KMS `requestId` is visible. We'll replace principalId with an alias but keep the requestId unchanged.

Field Auditor: :thumbsup: That mapping + requestIDs is exactly what we need. Once you upload the sanitized bundle to the secure share, we'll validate sample items. If you can add a small CSV that maps each sample row to the control (e.g., sample1 -> CC6.1, sample2 -> A.9.2), it speeds up review.

Ruchi: Thanks all — I'll assemble the bundle and aim to upload to the secure share by EOD tomorrow. Will ping here with the link and manifest. CC: @Sam for redaction sign-off.

Jordan: Working on queries now, will paste redacted snippets here when ready.

Mina: I'll snapshot the PR approvals and grab the Codeowners diff.

Sam: I'll review redaction and sign-off before upload.

Field Auditor: Great, appreciate the quick turnaround.
